title: Claude Code Safety Hooks: Block Destructive Bash Commands Before They Execute
micro_problem: AI coding agents can accidentally execute destructive shell commands unless a pre-execution hook blocks obvious high-risk patterns.
before_state: The learner uses AI coding tools without a local safety hook for destructive Bash commands.
after_state: The learner can install, test, and reason about a local PreToolUse-style Bash safety hook that blocks destructive patterns and logs attempts.
audience: Developers and AI-assisted coders who use terminal-capable coding agents.
forbidden_claims: Students achieved results before any students exist.
positive_ethics_claim: Teaches practical defensive tooling that can reduce accidental destructive command execution and improve developer agency.
revenue_path: Free lesson first, optional paid beta course only for opt-in buyers, with clear limitations and refund policy.

title: Build a Zero-Negative-Ethics AI Agent Baseline
micro_problem: People want autonomous agents but lack a practical ledger-first safety scaffold for experiments.
before_state: The learner has an agent idea but no clean method for cost, ethics, action, and revenue ledgers.
after_state: The learner can scaffold a local dry-run agent with separated positive/negative ethics and cost tracking.
audience: AI builders, researchers, and indie developers.
forbidden_claims: This makes your agent legally safe.
This will make your agent profitable.
positive_ethics_claim: Helps builders measure and constrain autonomous systems before external deployment.
revenue_path: Free scaffold explanation first, optional paid templates or workshop only for opt-in buyers.
